test_title: PYST 19: SSC CHSL - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 7 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: If a man were to sell his home theatre system for ₹14,400, he would lose 25%. But if he wants to gain 20%, the item should be sold for:
solution:
**Given:**

Selling price at 25% loss = ₹14,400

Gain wanted = 20%

**Formula used:**

S.P = ((100+gain\%))/(100)× C.P

S.P = ((100-loss\%))/(100)× C.P

**Calculation:**

According to the question, 

S.P at 25% loss = Rs. 14,400

⇒ ((100-25))/(100) × C.P = 14,400

⇒ C.P = 14,400 × (100)/(75)

⇒ C.P = 19,200

Hence, C.P = Rs.19,200

Now, S.P at 20% gain 

⇒ ((100+20))/(100)× 19,200

⇒ (120)/(100) × 19,200

⇒ Rs.23,040

**therefore To gain 20%, the item should be sold for Rs.23,040.**
